craftlocator.complete: [CraftLocator] Search radius %s; blocks checked %s, sections %s, loaded chunks %s, skipped unloaded sections %s. Results describe observations during the scan, limited to loaded areas.
craftlocator.position: Coordinates: %s | Dimension: %s | Distance: %s blocks (from starting position)
craftlocator.kind.potential: Potential source block; item is not physically present
craftlocator.not_found: [CraftLocator] No match for %s in the examined loaded area. Other areas may contain it.
craftlocator.station_missing: [CraftLocator] No existing %s found in the scanned loaded area; see the station recipe above.
craftlocator.failed: [CraftLocator] Operation failed (%s). Check server logs or reduce the request.
craftlocator.status: [CraftLocator] Target: %s | State: %s | Progress: %s%% | Blocks: %s | Chunks: %s | Elapsed: %s ms | Results: %s
craftlocator.radius: [CraftLocator] Radius must be between 1 and the server limit of %s.
craftlocator.permission: [CraftLocator] Permission denied. Ask the server administrator to grant access.
craftlocator.disabled: [CraftLocator] This feature is disabled by the server administrator.
craftlocator.no_mapping: [CraftLocator] No known world-source mapping for %s. Existing dropped items and explicitly authorized containers can still be searched.
craftlocator.unsupported: [CraftLocator] A recipe exists for %s, but automatic material analysis is unavailable for this recipe type.
craftlocator.no_recipe: [CraftLocator] No supported shaped or shapeless crafting recipe is available for %s.
craftlocator.crafting: [CraftLocator] Crafting %s ×%s | Chosen recipe: %s (bounded greedy heuristic, not a guaranteed optimum).
craftlocator.requirement: Required: %s ×%s | Inventory allocated: %s | Missing before intermediate crafts: %s
craftlocator.no_missing: [CraftLocator] No base materials missing; intermediate crafts may still be required.
craftlocator.surplus: Planned surplus after crafting: %s ×%s (not an existing inventory item)
craftlocator.station_required: [CraftLocator] Crafting Table required for the selected crafting sequence.
craftlocator.no_station: [CraftLocator] Selected crafting sequence fits the player crafting grid; no table required.
craftlocator.station_recipe: [CraftLocator] If no table exists, its selected recipe is: %s
craftlocator.analysis_only: [CraftLocator] Recipe analysis only. World coordinates require separate world-search permission.
craftlocator.help.find_block: /craftlocate find block <block_id> [radius] — e.g. minecraft:diamond_ore 64. Operator by default.
craftlocator.help.find_item: /craftlocate find item <item_id> [radius] — e.g. minecraft:diamond. Finds existing item entities; containers require explicit authorization.
craftlocator.help.source: /craftlocate source <item_id> [radius] — existing items plus declared potential harvest/processing sources.
craftlocator.help.craft: /craftlocate craft <item_id> [quantity] [radius] — e.g. minecraft:diamond_pickaxe 1 64. Read-only inventory and recursive recipe analysis.
craftlocator.help.controls: /craftlocate status — counters; /craftlocate cancel — stop; /craftlocate help — this reference. A new search replaces your previous one.
craftlocator.help.limits: Searches are 3D, current dimension only, and never load/generate chunks. Unloaded areas are omitted. Conditions and block-centre distances do not guarantee harvestability. Click coordinates to copy.
craftlocator.condition.unknown: Potential source only. Check harvesting tools, loot conditions and any required processing.
craftlocator.condition.diamond: Potential harvest: iron-tier pickaxe or better, without Silk Touch; loot conditions apply. Current tool suitability is not verified.
craftlocator.condition.coal: Potential harvest: suitable pickaxe without Silk Touch; loot conditions apply. Tool suitability is not verified.
craftlocator.condition.iron: Potential iron source: harvest raw iron with a stone-tier pickaxe or better without Silk Touch, then smelt using a furnace or blast furnace and fuel. No finished ingot is implied.
craftlocator.condition.gold: Potential gold source: harvest raw gold with an iron-tier pickaxe or better without Silk Touch, then smelt with a furnace or blast furnace and fuel.
craftlocator.condition.copper: Potential copper source: harvest raw copper with a stone-tier pickaxe or better without Silk Touch, then smelt with a furnace or blast furnace and fuel.
craftlocator.condition.wood: Potential wood source: harvest the log/stem, then use a supported crafting recipe for planks. Loot conditions apply.
craftlocator.condition.redstone: Potential harvest: iron-tier pickaxe or better, without Silk Touch; loot conditions apply.
craftlocator.condition.emerald: Potential harvest: iron-tier pickaxe or better, without Silk Touch; loot conditions apply.
craftlocator.condition.lapis: Potential harvest: stone-tier pickaxe or better, without Silk Touch; loot conditions apply.
craftlocator.condition.bamboo: Potential harvest: break bamboo; loot conditions apply. Crafting transformations may be necessary.
